name: aieo
description: Check a site's build output for SEO and AI-search defects and fix them in the source files; read crawler logs and Search Console data against the build. Needs the aieo CLI on PATH.

interface.shortDescription: SEO and AI-search checks for a site's build, fixed in the source
interface.longDescription: aieo reads what the build produced and what the framework and host declare, and reports defects with the build file and the source file to change: sitemap, robots.txt, canonical, hreflang, broken links, llms.txt, structured data, trailing slash and redirects. It also reads crawler access logs and Search Console / Bing data against the build. Every tool is read-only; IndexNow submissions and uploads are returned as plans for you to run.
defaultPrompt: Check this site's build for SEO and AI-search problems and fix them
Set up an aieo check in CI that fails only on new problems
Do AI crawlers reach my pages? Read the access logs
